notes.title: Service Termination Notice
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who has enjoyed Crazy Farm.
Unfortunately, we are forced to end the game service.
Please refrain from making any further purchases.

The server will also shut down on Friday, October 25.

Thank you for your support all this time.

notes.title: UPDATE for Multi-Language Support - Add New 6 Languages!

UPDATE for Multi-Language Support - Add 6 Languages!

In addition to English and Korean, 6 languages have been added to support a total of eight languages.
Currently supported languages and additional languages are listed below.

notes.title: 'Non - VR Mode' has been Update - Even if you have not any VR devices, you can enjoy the game!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33094655/a9d34b0a20205252c462f0759564663c227f9d9a.jpg[/img]
'Non - VR Mode' has been updated!

Surprisingly, now you can enjoy Crazy Farm without VR With mobile! Of course, you can also enjoy the game alone.

[list]
[*] If VR is not connected, game will be launched to PC mode automatically.
[*] You can start the game by pressing 'Space bar'.
[*] Please refer to below for PC play method of each game.
[/list]

[h1]Protect the Farm[/h1]
[list]
[*] Press 'Space bar' to start the game.
[*] Use 'Arrow keys' to move your character.
[*] Move quickly by holding down the 'Shift' button.
[*] Press 'Space bar' to swipe the broom.
[/list]

[h1]Protect the truck[/h1]
[list]
[*] Press 'Space bar' to start the game.
[*] Use 'Arrow keys' to move your character.
[*] Move quickly by holding down the 'Shift key'.
[*] Press and hold 'Space bar' to throw a bomb (the longer you push the key, the farther you can throw)
[/list]

[h1]Protect the barn[/h1]
[list]
[*] Press 'Space bar' to start the game.
[*] Use 'Arrow keys' to move your character.
[*] Move quickly by holding down the 'Shift key'.
[*] Press 'Space bar' to swipe the broom.
[/list]

notes.title: New Episode Update! - Add 2 new mini game
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33094655/46da50dc050483c9af37546d6efe6519ce6e43ed.png[/img]
You can enjoy 3 games with 2 new mini games!

[h1]Protect the truck[/h1]
In 'Protect the truck' mode, VR user should throw apple bombs to prevent animals from reaching the truck. mobile user needs to hit a move button repeatedly to avoid an apology bomb and acquire an apple in the truck.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33094655/09266cfb70dabff95069c07b272a99a335628cd3.png[/img]

[h1]Protect the barn[/h1]
In 'Protect the barn' mode, it is necessary for the VR user to hit the animal flying to the barn using two brooms. mobile users need to fly in a safe direction to avoid farmers' broom and get apple.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33094655/c1e24c1a1dd1f2929f1c9d4ce0105c5b8dd70fff.png[/img]
